thread.subject: Their PO says their terms apply - which wins?

message.text:
Hi,

Sandbrook have raised a PO for the September delivery and the PO says 'supplier's acceptance is subject to Sandbrook's standard purchasing terms'. We already have a signed supply agreement with them from 2024. Their purchasing terms have 60-day payment and an uncapped indemnity.

The warehouse wants to ship on Friday. Which terms actually apply?

Lola
